Buy without an account

Paste the wallet the AXONCoins should go to, pick a pack, and pay. No signup. They are sent from the treasury straight to that address.

Copy it from your wallet rather than typing it — a wrong address is a real address belonging to somebody else, and a transfer to it cannot be reversed. We check it before charging your card, but we cannot check that it is yours. Sign in instead if you want the purchase kept in an account.

{% elif not wallet %}

{% else %}
Delivering to {{ wallet }}. Payment is handled by Stripe — card details never reach this site. {# What happens next, in plain terms. Somebody who has just paid and sees nothing in their wallet has no way to tell a working queue from a scam, and saying nothing is what makes them assume the worse one. #}
After you pay: your AXONCoins are sent from the treasury automatically, usually within a minute or two. You will see the transaction on Ethereum and the balance in your own wallet — we never hold them for you.
If the network is congested or a transfer fails, it is queued for an operator instead and sent by hand, normally the same day. Either way the purchase is recorded against your account and nothing is lost — this page will show it as awaiting delivery until it lands.
Seeing nothing in MetaMask? A wallet shows no token until you add it once — how to add AXONCoins. That is the most common reason a delivered balance looks missing.
